patterns.note: WorkbenchTool + ToolDescriptor provide stable tool identity, grouping, context kind, host hints and binding capabilities.
WorkspaceToolInstance owns Binding; different pinned Event targets create sibling instances instead of silently retargeting.
WorkspaceEditScopeResolver derives WHO / WHERE / HOW MANY from canonical document state plus binding.
WorkbenchSurfaceController separates gesture candidate geometry from committed/saveable layout; viewport projection does not rewrite canonical geometry.
One InteractionOverlayRegistry aggregates semantic interaction proxies shared by workspace presentations.

source_files.role: ToolInstance identity + explicit binding + pinned sibling lifecycle
committed surface state + viewport projection + versioned persistence

mechanism: Tool names remain persistence keys; ToolDescriptor declares context, binding support, duplication and preferred host.
WorkspaceBinding resolves FollowFocus, FollowSelection and PinnedEvent against canonical Event identity.
openPinnedEvent preserves an existing pinned primary and creates a sibling for a different pinned target.
WorkspaceEditScopeResolver is explanatory UI only; it does not own domain state.
SurfaceGeometry.inViewport projects saved geometry into the current viewport without overwriting it.
WorkbenchSurfaceController keeps transient move/resize candidates separate from committed geometry.
InteractionOverlayRegistry collects semantic proxies independently of the final renderer.
implementation_effects: A tool instance can remain bound to one Event while global Focus changes.
Missing pinned Events become explicit unresolved states rather than falling back to Focus.
Shared Style edits can expose the affected Event count before mutation.
Drag/resize cancellation restores committed window layout and only committed geometry is serialized.
Tool discovery and preview interaction can be hosted across fixed/Canvas presentations without duplicating domain ownership.
responsive_contract: Surface geometry is stored in dp and projected to current viewport bounds at presentation time.
Layout lock affects presentation movement/resize, not object binding or editability.
Workspace presentation may change while stable ToolInstance and Binding identities remain.
limitations: Only some tools currently support explicit pinned Event binding; Canvas duplication must not be interpreted as universal independent target support.
This record proves production source mechanisms and tests, not a production screenshot or pixel baseline.
Renderer authority remains outside the interaction overlay; overlay anchors are not claimed as exact glyph hit-testing.
